spec.question: Count admission records in the installed MIMIC-IV database.
spec.time_window: all available admissions in the installed release
spec.denominator: all admission records; no population inference
assumptions: One admissions row corresponds to one hospital admission

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_admissions FROM mimiciv_hosp.admissions
limitations: Illustrative proposal, not a benchmark prediction
Installed data release must be independently verified
